comments.name: Test Reader One
comments.text: The tip about soaking with just enough water worked. First time my khichdi did not turn into one sticky lump.

replies.name: Prashant Dhingra
replies.text: Glad it helped. Pearl size varies by brand, so keep notes on how much water your brand needs.

comments.name: Test Reader Two
comments.text:
Can I make this ahead for a work lunch?

I fast most of the nine days and cook the night before.

replies.name: Test Reader Three
replies.text: I do. Reheat with a splash of water and a little ghee and it softens again.
